tokens.name: sage-teal
tokens.usage: Signature ground of the gold-foil posts (the elephant). Brand ground, same in both themes. Gold-light or ivory text on it reaches only 2.5 to 3.4:1: use it behind illustration and display type of 48px+, never behind body copy.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Ground of the condensed-caps affirmation posts. Brand ground. White on it is 2.7:1 as in the source posts; put ink on it for anything that must be read, or keep white to 56px+ display only.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Ground of the handwritten-script posts, the 'evening' colour. Brand ground. Ivory script on it is 3.8:1: display sizes only (28px+).

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Ground of the rose-line posts and event announcements. Brand ground. Ink, ink-muted, gold-ink and rose-ink all read on it in the light theme.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Ground of the feather post. Brand ground, the warmest. Ink and gold-ink read on it; ink-muted and rose-ink do not (under 4.5:1).

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: The lotus line colour on blush, and the light ink on sage-deep and slate. Brand neutral, same in both themes.

tokens.name: gold-foil
tokens.usage: Deep tone of the gold foil (feather shaft, 'CALM'). Decorative fills, rules and illustration only. As text it reaches 2.0:1 on peach, 3.0:1 on surface: use gold-ink for words.

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Highlight tone of the gold foil on sage-teal (the elephant quote). Display quotes on sage-deep (4.7:1) or on sage-teal at 48px+ only, where it is 2.5:1 and decorative, as in the source.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: The rose-gold lotus and 'LET GO' type on blush. Decorative strokes and oversized display only: 1.9:1 on blush, as in the source. Use rose-ink for readable rose text.

tokens.name: sage-deep
tokens.usage: Added for legibility: a deepened sage-teal for primary buttons, banners and any sage panel that carries body text. Ivory on it is 6.3:1, gold-light 4.7:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for screens and documents.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and inputs above surface.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet panels, session listings and callouts. Blush in light, a muted sage in dark.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface, surface-raised, surface-tint, blush and peach (light: 7.8:1 or more); on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint in dark (9:1 or more).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, dates and control borders on surface, surface-raised, surface-tint and blush (4.5:1 or more in both themes). Not on peach (4.4:1).

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Readable gold: links, eyebrows, the wordmark in running UI, emphasis words. On surface, surface-raised, surface-tint, blush and peach in light (4.7:1 or more); on surface, surface-raised and surface-tint in dark (6.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Readable rose: attributions ('- Yoda'), secondary emphasis on blush and surface (5.2:1 or more). Not on peach in light (4.3:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between list rows and sections. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill. Sage-deep in light, gold in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent: 6.3:1 light, 8.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring with a 2px offset. At least 4.7:1 on every light surface including peach, 7:1 on dark surfaces.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The brand name in type, always uppercase with wide tracking, as on every source post. Gold-ink on light grounds, gold-light on sage-deep.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero lines on web and the opening slide of a deck. One per screen.

styles.name: display-italic
styles.usage: The 'by' in the ByPilares lockup and short italic asides inside headings.

styles.name: quote-l
styles.usage: The gold-foil quote voice of the posts: light geometric sans, sentence case, centred. Social cards and hero quotes.

styles.name: quote-m
styles.sample: El problema no son las emociones incómodas
styles.usage: Longer quotes (two lines or more) and pull quotes in articles.

styles.name: poster-l
styles.usage: Tall thin caps for one-to-three-word affirmations. Uppercase always.

styles.name: poster-m
styles.usage: Multi-line affirmations in caps with generous leading, as in the 'última llave' post.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, session names, form section headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Un espacio para sostener lo que sientes, sin juicio.
styles.usage: Running text. Never lighter than 400 below 20px.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase category labels above titles, in gold-ink or ink-muted.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Ahí donde te rompes, es por donde entra la luz…
styles.usage: Handwritten reflections on slate. Quotes only, never UI, never under 28px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related elements; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between card groups; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section breathing room; social-card inner margin at 1080px (scaled).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom space. Silence is part of the brand: prefer more space over more elements.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Social cards, posters and images: the source posts are square-cornered.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs and tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets in product UI.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons. The soft pill echoes the petal curve of the lotus.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Default. The brand is flat: depth comes from colour grounds, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Only for a floating sheet or menu over imagery.
